templateDescription: A warm, timeless family photo book template featuring ivory backgrounds, burgundy accents, and elegant serif typography. Designed to celebrate generations, everyday moments, and the stories that bind families together.

display.fallback: Libre Baskerville, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif
display.usage: family name, chapter titles, milestone headings

body.fallback: Source Sans Pro, Open Sans, sans-serif

textAlignmentSystem.description: Comprehensive text alignment rules for consistent, beautiful typography
principles: All centered text uses transform: translateX(-50%) from left: 50%
Multi-line text blocks use text-align with explicit width containers
Vertical positioning uses percentage-based top values for scalability
Caption text aligns to photo edges, not page edges
Script/decorative text slightly offset above main titles for visual hierarchy

photoAligned.textAlign: left or right based on photo position
